name: Honda XL100 / XL125
engine: 99 or 124 cc air-cooled overhead-cam single, carb
intro: Honda's small dual-sports of the 70s and early 80s. Simple singles with points and six-volt electrics on many.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
